parameters.query:
select
  (select count(*) from orders
    where late_flagged_at > now() - interval '24 hours') as late_flagged_24h,
  (select count(*) from orders where late_flagged) as late_flagged_total,
  (select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where order_delivered_customer_date::date > order_estimated_delivery_date::date)
          / count(*) filter (where order_delivered_customer_date is not null), 1)
     from orders) as late_rate_pct,
  (select count(*) from reviews
    where triaged_at > now() - interval '24 hours') as reviews_triaged_24h,
  (select json_agg(t) from (
     select ai_category, count(*) as n from reviews
     where triaged_at is not null
     group by ai_category order by n desc) t) as complaint_breakdown;
